The shiny-discuss group gets a broader audience of Shiny users. shinyapps-users is focused on hosting Shiny apps on shinyapps.io.
That is why I suggested posting there.

That said, 3200 vs 2300 columns against 22000 rows is a difference of nearly 20 million cells. Compressing down to 7MB is fine for transferring files over the internet, but they will be uncompressed and then loaded into memory.
